_about: Public-domain Nicolaus Ludwig von Zinzendorf (1700-1760, bishop of the Moravian Church) in English for the Word Hoard: Sixteen Discourses on the Redemption of Man by the Death of Christ, preached at Berlin (London: James Hutton, catalogued 1740), and Seven Sermons on the Godhead of the Lamb (London: James Hutton, 1742), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 31 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
